create_ComposableQuantizer: create a ComposableQuantizer that combines multiple quantizers into a single quantizer for model quantization
build_quantization_pipeline: build a quantization pipeline by composing embedding, linear, and XNNPack quantizers in sequence
annotate_model: annotate a torch fx GraphModule by applying multiple quantizers in composition order
validate_quantized_model: validate a quantized torch fx GraphModule after annotation with composable quantizers
record_and_validate_annotations: record and validate quantization annotations on graph nodes to detect conflicts between quantizers
